# Official public C algorithm input

Unmodified Molly Rocket Meow Hash 0.5/calico native C header, used under the
user-authorized public C algorithm exception. No Jai implementation is consulted.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cmuratori/meow_hash/master/meow_hash_x64_aesni.h

Fetched 2026-10-14. SHA-256:
`2328557212adc48ee3e8e8c9d25820a43b2fc0c48cf4296ab9b0b1ba52d376e2`.

The full zlib license and 2018–2019 Molly Rocket copyright notice remain at the
start of the unmodified header. New Jai adaptations are separately identified;
reviewed Jai declarations/data remain the API oracle. Any C comparison program
is built from this permitted source in our target directory, never supplied as a
reference binary. Public register/memory/state contracts are reviewed separately.
